hero.title: Namaste: Your Gateway to Exquisite Indian Cuisine and Warm Hospitality
hero.subtitle: Discover the vibrant tastes and aromatic spices of India, crafted with passion and served with a smile.

about.title: Experience the Heart of India at Namaste
about.paragraph1: At Namaste, we believe food is a celebration of culture and community. Our journey began with a simple desire: to bring the true, diverse flavors of India to your plate. Every dish is a testament to traditional recipes, fresh ingredients, and the culinary heritage passed down through generations.
about.paragraph2: Step into our welcoming space and let the fragrant aromas transport you. From classic curries and tandoori delights to innovative vegetarian options and delightful desserts, our menu offers a memorable dining experience. We are more than just a restaurant; we are a destination where every meal feels like a warm embrace.
